purpose: Keep JNU analysis usable on desktop and mobile while preserving exact-data provenance and preventing proxy data from masquerading as live OSE order-flow.

local_bridge.credential_rule: Reuse MARKET_AI_HUB Windows Credential Manager and single-owner lifecycle. JNU Research must not create a second Yuanta login or store broker credentials.

requirements: Exact active JNU individual-month contract identity is verified.
Fresh exact trade callback is present.
Fresh bid/ask depth callback is present.
Exact JNU contract-level trades/tick-detail are available.
Depth callback is absent or unverified.
allowed: trade delta / aggressor-flow when source fields support it
spread only when exact bid/ask is present

requirements: User supplies current JNU price or a current broker-app screenshot/quote.
allowed: anchor support/resistance and operation scenarios to the user-supplied exact JNU price
prohibited: claiming user-supplied last price is a continuous feed

requirements: No user-supplied exact JNU current price.
source_order: fresh individual-contract exact Micro quote from approved cloud source if it independently passes the current <=900-second identity/freshness gate
JPX delayed exact Micro only as delayed reference, never live order-flow
Nikkei futures/mini/cash, TOPIX, USDJPY, NQ/QQQ/SMH, VIX/Nikkei VI, rates, breadth, events and news as labeled proxies/context
prohibited: pretending proxy price is exact JNU
modes.operation_rule: Prefer conditional/relative plans. If exact price is missing, state that exact execution levels must be re-anchored at market open or from the user's broker quote.

requirements: Critical current market/event evidence is stale, contradictory or unavailable beyond safe fallback.

freshness.rule: The 900-second gate is only an outer eligibility ceiling. L2/order-flow interpretation requires materially fresher observations; stale depth is never treated as live.

mobile_rule: Mobile use must never require the local PC to answer. If local is unavailable, automatically use the highest available nonlocal mode and disclose the mode in the answer.
no_blocking_rule: Do not ask the user to reconnect the PC before providing a best-effort JNU analysis. Use cloud fallback first; a user-provided current JNU quote/screenshot is optional enrichment.
no_double_login_rule: When MARKET_AI_HUB is available, reuse its existing Yuanta owner/recorder and local credential store. Never create a parallel broker session solely for JNU Research.

free_data_research_result.conclusion: Existing Yuanta entitlement through MARKET_AI_HUB is the best candidate for exact live JNU/tick/depth data; cloud fallback remains proxy/context unless an approved exact individual-contract source passes freshness.
